# Stickyy 1.1
## Floating Notes
- Press your Stickyy shortcut to toggle a clean, movable note above every app. - Keep working in the active menu-bar note or create a fresh note every time. - Floating notes work across Spaces and alongside full-screen apps. - The focused panel keeps the note editor only—no header, sharing button, or Clipboard Pills. - The original material and Liquid Glass appearances both remain available.
## In-app Updates
- Added secure Sparkle updates with signed downloads and automatic checks. - Added **Check for Updates…** and an automatic-check toggle in Settings. - Existing v1.0.1 users need to install v1.1 manually once. Later releases can be installed from inside Stickyy.
